text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how we work. One major impact is automation, where AI handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling, freeing employees to focus on more creative work. Productivity tools, such as smart email filters or project managers, help teams finish tasks faster with fewer errors. However, human-AI collaboration is key: AI offers suggestions and insights, but people still make final decisions and provide emotional judgment. This shift also means job changes. Some roles will disappear, but new ones will emerge, like AI trainers or ethics officers. The successful workplace will be one where humans and machines work together, each playing to their strengths.
